xhs.title: XHS service console
xhs.description: Send real requests through Vite, Traefik and Oathkeeper to xhs_service. The browser only carries the Kratos Session cookie; Oathkeeper creates the internal JWT.
xhs.signInDescription: These routes require a Kratos browser Session so Oathkeeper can issue an internal JWT.
xhs.organizationHint: Loaded from the current user's Keto organization relationships.

startTask.title: Start crawl task
startTask.description: Create a mock task using comma- or line-separated keywords.

contents.title: View crawl contents
contents.description: Read the mocked content list visible to this organization.

keywords.title: Update keywords
keywords.description: Replace the organization's mock crawl keyword configuration.
